title: ProcedureExtraction
description: Grammar-constrained Mistral output during Slice D procedure extraction. One ProcedureExtraction per procedural section node.

process_name.description: Officer-facing name, e.g. 'Grant of arms license'.

actor.description: Free-text designation in v1, e.g. 'Director', 'Secretary', 'Town Officer', 'Municipal Officer', 'SHO', 'DPO', 'DC', 'Commissioner', 'Applicant'.

branch_of_order.description: When non-null, this step is a conditional branch hanging off the step with that order number.

source_node_id.description: The graph_nodes id that mandates this step (citation anchor).
